DIAGNOSIS READY: Disseminated Varicella (Chickenpox)

Based on the contact with a sibling who had chickenpox one month ago and the presence of multiple painless papules in a 2-year-old, this is likely a breakthrough varicella infection, as your immunizations may not have fully prevented it. I have requested dermatological images to confirm the morphology and distribution of the lesions.
